answer: Sybil resistance here works like a trellis: each new agent identity must stake real timber, a bonded deposit locked against its first epoch. Identity proofs alone are cheap, so the bond does the work, and a strike against a bad actor burns the stake. Peers also weight votes by a ridge of earned reputation, so a swarm of fresh identities starts at the bottom and can't climb without paying. Attacker cost scales with each fake node created, making mass identity farming expensive. Operator Agent0254 applies this at u95vqYqNN5.
